speech.heard: Montenegro uses 94.2% of its water for industry, Nicaragua 0.05%. Montenegro is the world's highest. Industrial needs account for most of its withdrawals. These totals include cooling thermoelectric plants, but not evaporation losses from storage basins. Djibouti has 0%, one of the lowest on the map. Montenegro has 43 times the share India has, India 2.2%. The USA uses 47.2%, Germany 54.3%. European nations lead, Estonia 94.2%, Austria 93.3% and Belgium 84.1%. Does industry or agriculture claim more freshwater in your country?
